## Context
The GitHub About description currently says Rebar is an LLM-first event-sourced ticket system and Jira reconciler, then identifies GitHub as a read-only mirror. It does not explain the capability that distinguishes Rebar from conventional trackers. ADR 0018 and the plan-review gate guidance establish enforceable review before claim. The completion gate and operation-certificate guidance establish signed verification before close.

## Plan
- Replace the `navapbc/rebar` repository description with concise client-facing wording that leads with plan review.
- State the observable mechanisms rather than make an unsupported superiority claim.
- Preserve the read-only GitHub mirror and Gerrit code-review facts.
- Keep the description within GitHub limits and avoid internal implementation terms.
- Read the repository metadata back after the update and record the exact value.
- Change GitHub repository metadata only.

## Proposed Description
Rebar can block work until an AI plan review passes, require signed completion verification before close, and reconcile its event-sourced ticket record with Jira across CLI, Python, and MCP. GitHub is a read-only mirror. Code review runs in Gerrit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The GitHub About description leads with enforceable plan review before work begins.
- [x] It names signed completion verification, event-sourced history, Jira reconciliation, and the CLI, Python, and MCP interfaces.
- [x] It preserves the read-only mirror and Gerrit review facts.
- [x] It fits the GitHub repository-description limit.
- [x] `gh repo view navapbc/rebar --json description` returns the approved description exactly.
- [x] No repository file, homepage URL, or topic changes.
